item.title: 1994 Ford F-150 XLT 4×4
item.description: This 1994 Ford F-150 XLT 4×4 short-bed pickup is said to have remained on a farm in Northern California through 2025 and now has 99k miles. It is finished in Colonial White over Medium Mocha vinyl and powered by a 4.9-liter inline-six linked with a four-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case. item.description: This 2010 Mercedes-Benz GLK350 4MATIC has 47k miles following registration history in North Carolina, and it remained in the original owner's care until December 2025. item.title: 1988 Saab 900 Turbo SPG 5-Speed
item.description: This 1988 Saab 900 Turbo SPG was sold new at Garry Small Saab in Portland, Oregon, and remained registered in that state and California until the seller's purchase in 2018. Finished in Edwardian Gray Metallic over Buffalo Gray leather upholstery, the car is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transaxle. item.title: 28k-Mile 2004 Lincoln Town Car Signature at No Reserve
item.description: This 2004 Lincoln Town Car Signature spent approximately one year with its original owner before it spent the next 19 years with its second owner in Florida, and it was purchased in 2025 by the seller. Indicating 28k miles, the car is powered by a 4.6-liter V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission and is finished in black over matching leather. item.description: This 2003 BMW Z8 was ordered by its current owner through McKenna BMW in Norwalk, California, and it was initially collected via European Tourist delivery. item.title: 15k-Mile 2012 Ferrari 458 Spider at No Reserve
item.description: This 2012 Ferrari 458 Spider was initially delivered to The Collection of Coral Gables, Florida, and spent time in Michigan and Nevada before it was acquired by the current owner on BaT in June 2023, and it now has 15k miles. The car is finished in Bianco Avus over Nero leather upholstery and is powered by a 4.5-liter DOHC V8 linked with a seven-speed dual-clutch automatic transaxle and an electronic rear differential. item.title: 43-Years-Owned 1962 Porsche 356B Coupe at No Reserve
item.description: This 1962 Porsche 356B coupe was acquired by the current owner in California in 1983, and it is powered by a replacement 1.6L flat-four sourced from a 912 and paired with a four-speed manual transaxle. It is finished in Signal Red over tan leather, and features include 15" steel wheels, four-wheel disc brakes, a sunroof, headlight grilles, body-color bumpers, a Pioneer stereo, and a Nardi steering wheel. item.description: This 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera is one of 25 examples modified by Gunther Werks to their Speedster specification in a build that was completed in October 2022. item.title: 2006 Ford GT Heritage Edition
item.description: This 2006 Ford GT is #248 of 343 Heritage Edition examples produced, and it was first delivered to Claremont Ford in Claremont, California. It has 13k miles, and it remained registered in California and in the original owner's care until December 2024. The car is finished in Heritage Blue and Epic Orange over Ebony leather, and it was factory optioned with forged aluminum BBS wheels, red-finished brake calipers, and a McIntosh stereo system.
